# Requirements: Lendshed

**Defined:** 2026-01-12
**Core Value:** A member can see what is on the shelf at every shed and borrow it without asking a steward to look it up.

## v1 Requirements

Requirements for initial release. Each maps to roadmap phases.

### Member Data

- [x] **MEMB-01**: A member record survives a server restart
- [x] **MEMB-02**: A request without the kiosk passcode is refused
- [x] **MEMB-03**: A member has a display name and a home shed
- [x] **MEMB-04**: A member's loan history is kept
- [x] **MEMB-05**: A member record survives a power cut

### Shed Inventory

- [x] **SHED-01**: A member can see live stock for every shed in one view
- [x] **SHED-02**: A member can see a tool's condition note
- [x] **SHED-03**: A tool flagged for repair shows a prominent badge
- [x] **SHED-04**: Stock updates without a page reload
- [x] **SHED-05**: A shed with no data never hides the healthy sheds

### Catalogue Browsing

- [x] **CATL-01**: A member can browse the tools of any shed
- [x] **CATL-02**: A member can browse by category
- [x] **CATL-03**: A member can see each tool's last loan date
- [x] **CATL-04**: A member can search tools by name
- [x] **CATL-05**: Browsing cannot reach a shed the member has no home in

### Transfers

- [x] **MOVE-01**: A steward can start a transfer between sheds
- [x] **MOVE-02**: A transfer in transit stays findable
- [x] **MOVE-03**: A receiving steward can confirm a transfer
- [x] **MOVE-04**: A transfer survives a server restart
- [x] **MOVE-05**: Every transfer is recorded in the loan log

## v2 Requirements

Deferred beyond v1.0.
